title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 17, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C2.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.0 (Peaked November 17, 2026 at 19:36 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.1 (Peaked November 17, 2026 at 15:49 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 350 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

The Sun is about halfway through its roughly 10-billion-year main-sequence lifetime. Still plenty of time before retirement. 🌞☀️

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
